claim: § The Pronunciation Lesson: "Code review couldn't catch this ... Only listening caught it." Three spellings of the spoken A ('A' -> 'uh', 'ay' -> 'eye', 'eigh' -> /eɪ/) are a claim only the ear can check.

pieces.what: Plays the three spellings side by side with the spec line that produced each, so the reader hears the bug the code review passed and the fix that landed
A playable 88-key strip: press a key, it says its name; velocity picks among the four Kokoro voices, so a mapping error is audible in the first second (tests 'instant audible verification')
pieces.walks_up_from: a single key at one velocity

pieces.what: One octave rendered in a solfège variant beside the letter names, to hear whether positional verification survives losing the letter
